_note: Fictional demo studios. Photos are Unsplash License images used as illustrations; the photographer is credited on every image.

studios.name: Atelier Vantreur
studios.bio: Sculptural eveningwear cut by hand in small numbers. Every gown starts as a paper toile and ends with a record of the hours it took.
studios.cv: Shown at Haute Couture Night (London) and Wearable Futures (Copenhagen). Works with two French mills on deadstock silk.

pieces.title: Nocturne gown
pieces.description: Black silk faille gown with batwing sleeves that fall into a pooled train. Cut from a single length of deadstock silk.
pieces.inspiration: Night swimming, and the way dark water closes behind you.

pieces.title: Folded paper bustier
pieces.description: Ivory cotton-silk bustier dress with origami folds that are set by hand and stitched invisibly from inside.

pieces.title: Ink rib gown
pieces.description: Iridescent ribbed bodice in hand-dyed taffeta over a tulle underskirt, finished with a sheer standing collar.
pieces.inspiration: The ribs of an umbrella turned inside out by the wind.

studios.name: Halcyon Knit Lab
studios.bio: A knitwear studio that hand-knits everything in traceable wool and publishes the yarn, the swatches and the hours for each piece.
studios.cv: Textile design studies in Copenhagen and Glasgow. Shown at the Wearable Art Triennial. Member since 2023.

pieces.title: Cloud rib sweater
pieces.description: Oversized hand-knitted rib sweater in undyed merino, long enough in the sleeve to swallow your hands.
pieces.inspiration: Fog on the Øresund in February.

pieces.title: Oxblood cable pullover
pieces.description: Dense cable knit in plant-dyed wool, with cables that run unbroken from hem to collar.

pieces.title: Moss lace cardigan (in progress)
pieces.description: Still on the needles: an openwork lace cardigan in moss-green wool. The archive records it while it is being made.

studios.name: Brandt & Mirelle
studios.bio: Jewellery studio working in recycled silver and gold, with stones bought one by one from named dealers.
studios.cv: Goldsmithing training in Amsterdam and Florence. Curator endorsement for the Harbour series.

pieces.title: Emerald cascade choker
pieces.description: Seventeen strands of seed pearls gathered into a cushion-cut emerald centre, edged with old-cut diamonds.
pieces.inspiration: A Mughal choker seen in a museum, rebuilt from memory.

pieces.title: Baroque pearl rope
pieces.description: Irregular baroque pearls knotted on silk, each knot tied by hand so no two pearls touch.
pieces.inspiration: Pearls that refuse to be round.

pieces.title: Harbour bead necklace
pieces.description: Glass beads in harbour blues with a gold-plated clasp shaped like a mooring hook.

pieces.title: Sun pendant chain
pieces.description: A hand-pierced sun in recycled silver on a fine trace chain.
pieces.inspiration: The first warm day of the year.

studios.name: Ossery Studio
studios.bio: A young London studio painting, coating and fringing garments by hand. Loud colour, slow work.
studios.cv: Graduated in fashion and printed textiles in 2023. First solo show: Abstract Fabric Surfaces, Rotterdam.

pieces.title: Spill dress
pieces.description: Strapless dress in organic cotton, hand-painted in layers of textile paint so the colours bleed like spilled ink.
pieces.inspiration: Abstract painting, colour flow and movement across fabric.

pieces.title: Liquid chrome set
pieces.description: Top and trousers in deadstock jersey, coated by hand in a flexible metallic finish.
pieces.inspiration: Mercury, and car paint at night.

pieces.title: Copper fringe dress
pieces.description: Short dress with tiers of hand-cut fringe that move like grass in wind.
pieces.inspiration: Savannah grass, seen from very close.

studios.name: Maison Quellane
studios.bio: Millinery and headpieces, blocked by hand on wooden forms. Somewhere between a hat and a small sculpture.
studios.cv: Trained in traditional millinery in Brussels. Headpieces for stage and runway.

pieces.title: Black filigree crown
pieces.description: A crown of lacquered black wire scrolls, light enough to wear all evening.

pieces.title: Sculpted straw brim
pieces.description: A wide sun hat in natural straw, blocked by hand and steamed into a soft wave.

pieces.title: Gilded bloom eyepiece
pieces.description: A gilded flower that covers one eye, held by a hidden band.
pieces.inspiration: A daisy pressed in a book and forgotten.

studios.name: Wrenfield Reclaim
studios.bio: Statement jewellery made only from reclaimed beads, chains and stones, each traced back to where it was found.
studios.cv: Guest studio. Works with estate sales and vintage dealers.

pieces.title: Salvaged jewel bib
pieces.description: A bib necklace built from 60 stones and beads rescued from broken costume jewellery.
pieces.inspiration: A jewellery box found at an estate sale.

pieces.title: Rivière, reworked
pieces.description: A broken rivière necklace, re-strung and reset with matching vintage paste stones.

pieces.title: Candy gem chain
pieces.description: Coloured stones from a dozen broken necklaces, joined on one long gold-tone chain.
